## Unzip Burn Severity Mosaics

This script unzips and compiles tif files from the mtbs dataset

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(fs)
library(zip)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
# ---- PATHS TO SET ----
zip_root <- "/Users/alyssajain/Downloads/composite_data"   # folder containing year subfolders
out_dir  <- "/Users/alyssajain/FIA/CA_mtbs_unzipped"              # folder to store the .tif files

dir_create(out_dir)

# ---- FIND ALL ZIP FILES ----
zip_files <- dir_ls(zip_root, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*.zip")

length(zip_files)

```

```{r}
for (z in zip_files) {
  
  # Create a temporary folder for extraction
  tmp_dir <- tempfile(pattern = "mtbs_")
  dir_create(tmp_dir)
  
  # Unzip
  unzip(z, exdir = tmp_dir)
  
  # Find any tif file inside the extracted structure
  tif_files <- dir_ls(tmp_dir, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*.tif")
  
  if (length(tif_files) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No TIFF found in:", z))
    next
  }
  
  # Build output filename (optional: preserve fire/year naming)
  tif_name <- path_file(tif_files[1])
  out_path <- path(out_dir, tif_name)
  
  # Copy the TIFF
  file_copy(tif_files[1], out_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  message("Extracted: ", tif_name)
  
  # Clean up temporary dir
  dir_delete(tmp_dir)
}

```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
